job-service's MCP server

Streamable HTTP at /mcp, stateless, answering JSON. Every request takes the submitters' bearer token (AUTH_TOKEN), as the API does, and may send claimed-by: each tool is one API request made with them, so it is refused, recorded and answered as that request would be. A refusal comes back as the tool's error, in the API's words. The contract is mcp.json; the API's is here.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "job-service": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4500/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer <AUTH_TOKEN>"
      }
    }
  }
}

Instructions

What the server tells an agent when it connects:

job-service runs jobs: a job is a named script in a repo's jobs.toml, a run one execution of it at one commit, claimed by a runner whose labels and free memory fit. - A run is submitted pending, claimed and running, and ends succeeded, failed or canceled with its exit code. - A run's log is read from a byte offset: get_run_log answers the bytes from offset, the log's size, and the run's state, so call it again from offset + the bytes read until the state has ended. - cancel_run ends a pending run at once; a running one is canceled by its runner shortly after. - Every tool takes the submitters' token this server was connected with. Registering runners and their claims and reports are the runner protocol, not tools.

Tools

  • submit_run Submit a run
  • list_runs List runs
  • get_run Get a run
  • get_run_log Read a run's log
  • cancel_run Cancel a run
  • list_runners List runners

submit_run

One run, stored pending until a runner whose labels and free memory fit claims it, with what it was for when for says. Nothing is checked against the repo here: a run of a job missing from jobs.toml at that commit fails on its runner, saying so in its log.

InputTypeRequired
repostringyesowner/name on GitHub.
commitstringyesThe commit to run, as a full lowercase sha: the runner checks out exactly this.
jobstringyesA [jobs.<name>] in the repo's jobs.toml at that commit, or in the routine directory's when it has a routine.
argsstring[]Appended to the job's run command from jobs.toml.
limitsobject
limits.memoryinteger or nullMiB the container may use, and the runner reserves for it. Null: jobs.toml's, within the 1024 MiB a run without one is admitted with.
limits.timeoutinteger or nullSeconds before the runner stops it and it fails. Null: jobs.toml's.
labelsobjectLabels as Kubernetes writes them. On a run, what a runner must have, every key with that value; on a runner, what it has.
forobject or nullWhat the run was for, as GET /runs?for=<kind>:<id> lists it.
routineobject or nullWhere the job's steps live, when not in its own repo: job is read from <dir>/jobs.toml in repo at commit, and the run's own repo and commit are its target, the package checked out at /work beside the routine. Only a runner that says it can run a routine claims it.
hoststring or nullThe machine it must run on, as a runner's hostId: claimed only by that machine's runner, and only one that says it can run host runs, which runs it on the host itself, with the host's user services, if that host's config lets it. Null: any runner that fits.

list_runs reads only

Returns runs matching every filter given, newest first.

InputTypeRequired
statepending, running, succeeded, failed, canceledpending until a runner claims it, running on that runner, then succeeded, failed or canceled, which it never leaves.
repostringowner/name on GitHub.
submittedBystringOnly the runs submitted with this claimed-by, as submittedBy records it.
forstring<kind>:<id>, e.g. item:28af81bc-…: only the runs submitted with that for.
limitintegerAt most this many, newest first.

get_run reads only

Returns one run.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe run's id.

get_run_log reads only

Returns the log from byte offset, at most 1 MiB, with the log's size so far and the run's state. Empty when offset is the log's size: call again later from there while the run is pending or running.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe run's id.
offsetintegerThe byte to read from; default 0.

cancel_run

A pending run ends canceled at once. A running one is marked cancelRequested: its runner is told on its next log append, stops it, and reports it canceled.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe run's id.

list_runners reads only

Returns every registered runner, most recently seen first, with its labels and host.

No input.
